book.under_world.hillside_house.title: Storage Log - Kira_99
book.under_world.hillside_house.page_1:
Day 12.
Finished putting glowstone into the floor today. Looks cozy under the glass roof!

Weird thing though: someone keeps digging right behind my back stone wall every midnight, even when the server player list is empty.
book.under_world.hillside_house.page_2:
Day 14.
Found a flickering static block embedded in the back corner of my chests. I tried mining it and my screen started shaking.

When I stepped onto the front walkway, Steve was standing by the stairs. Not a real player. His head twitched sideways 90 degrees.
book.under_world.hillside_house.page_3:
I locked the door and ran toward the clan terrace.

If anyone finds my house after the server restart, check the chests and DO NOT walk up close to Steve if you see him standing still near the hill.
book.under_world.clan_base_secret.title: ADMIN CONFESSION [BACKUP_14]
book.under_world.clan_base_secret.page_1:
If any of the clan finds this secret room under the floorboards, I am sorry I didn't shut down the host sooner.

Everybody thought 'friend' joining Day 1 was just a harmless cracked-account troll. It wasn't.
book.under_world.clan_base_secret.page_2:
Three nights ago Alex logged off in the dugout, yet his character walked into the courtyard an hour later.

When Misha walked up to ask why Alex wasn't answering Discord, his body burst into black pixels and tore open into four long limbs.
book.under_world.clan_base_secret.page_3:
It caught Misha by the pool. Now it wears HIS skin and HIS nametag on the road between bases.

I purged the console logs and threw away all the server backups so no one would track the seed.
book.under_world.clan_base_secret.page_4:
I hid down here with one redstone torch until the chunks unload. Even underwater isn't safe — something in the bay pulled Dima's oak boat straight down.

Leave the server. Do not touch the floating black sphere in the meadow.
book.under_world.mario_art.title: Pixel Build Notes - Dima_2015
book.under_world.mario_art.page_1:
Almost done building giant Mario out of wool at spawn meadow! Just two rows of red cap and the left scaffold left.

Wait. Who placed that glitchy cube inside Mario's ear? Nobody else has perms near my plot.
book.under_world.mario_art.page_2: Daylight suddenly snapped black for three seconds while I was on the ladder. When I looked down toward the river, something pitch black with rows of pale fangs surfaced right below the wooden bridge.
book.under_world.mario_art.page_3:
Leaving the wool and shears in the chest. I'm taking a boat across the lake back to Kira's hill — it's faster than walking.

Wait why is my boat dragging backward
book.under_world.monument.title: Server Archive #1
book.under_world.monument.page_1:
Erected in honor of our 2013 Alpha map before the first chunk corruption.

Original founders: Max, Alex_2014, Kira_99, Dima_2015, Leo.
book.under_world.monument.page_2:
Every time we reset the world seed, this statue spawns back in random meadows with one quartz eye missing.

Sometimes at dusk, redstone torches ignite by themselves while the regular torches go out.
book.under_world.monument.page_3:
The archive log ends at timestamp 03:17 with one line repeated forty times:

'this server is ^&^#&* please leave server the truth is here'
book.under_world.treehouse.title: Lookout Notes - Misha_Play
book.under_world.treehouse.page_1:
Built this lookout high in the big oak canopy so nothing from the forest could reach the ladder.

I swore I saw Alex standing under the trunk twenty minutes ago staring straight up.
book.under_world.treehouse.page_2: His neck snapped sideways twice without moving his feet. I pulled the hatch shut and tossed my bow down the ladder gap—wait no, I hear wet footsteps splashing below.
book.under_world.treehouse.page_3: Whatever that thing is, it doesn't stay disguised once you get close. I'm jumping out the north leaves toward the clan compound lights.
book.under_world.dugout.title: Hideout Entry - Alex_2014
book.under_world.dugout.page_1:
Dug a small bunker under the grass hill and masked the trapdoor with dirt.

A floating black sphere drifted across the plains yesterday. It stretched wide and shrank like it was breathing.
book.under_world.dugout.page_2: Leo accidentally brushed against the sphere while running past. He screamed in voice chat that his screen tilted sideways and white triangles filled his eyes until he walked off a ravine.
book.under_world.dugout.page_3: Keeping the iron bars shut. Keep your redstone torch low. If a player knocks above and spells words weird in chat, DO NOT open the hatch.
book.under_world.spawn_hub.title: Server Rules [OLD]
book.under_world.spawn_hub.page_1:
Welcome to UnderCraft (2013-2015)!
1. Respect builds & clan borders.
2. No griefing spawn or pixel art.
3. Check staff board for events.
book.under_world.spawn_hub.page_2:
[MODERATOR NOTICE — LEO]
Ignore any join alerts from 'friend' after 18:00. We did NOT whitelist that account and Mojang session servers return null UUID.
book.under_world.spawn_hub.page_3:
[EMERGENCY LOCKDOWN]
Spawn protection failed. Clock statues are appearing in unloaded chunks. Teleport back to overworld spawn disabled.

EVERYONE LOG OUT NOW.
book.under_world.trading_hall.title: Market Quarantine - Trader_Vova
book.under_world.trading_hall.page_1:
Set up three stalls for emeralds, enchanted books, and iron armor before the clan war.

Sales were booming until Tuesday night when the lamps flickered.
book.under_world.trading_hall.page_2: All three villagers stopped sleeping in their beds at once. They just stood behind the fences staring at the exact same dark hill coordinate outside the door.
book.under_world.trading_hall.page_3:
Closed the oak doors and left my emeralds in the crate.

If you're reading this: don't trade with them after sundown, and don't walk near the river behind the market.
book.under_world.computer_desk.title: PC Troubleshooting - Admin_Max
book.under_world.computer_desk.page_1:
Picked up this beige CRT tower from an abandoned house near the powerlines.

When you right-click the monitor, the entire room blurs into a green Windows XP hill.
book.under_world.computer_desk.page_2:
All the desktop shortcuts turned black and crashed into the grass when I walked up to them — except Chrome.

Inside the browser I found a site called 'the MinECRaT fREe downladn'.
book.under_world.computer_desk.page_3:
NEVER press the green DOWNLOAD button unless you are ready to sprint LEFT immediately.

Break or touch the portal that opens on the left to bring the Computer back with you.
